entities.name: Vincent DePaul Breen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vincent DePaul Breen was an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church who served as the third bishop of the Diocese of Metuchen in central New Jersey from 1997 until his resignation in 2002.
